news.title: Private equity investment in Indian real estate rises 16% to $4.5 billion in Jan-Sep 2026
news.para: Private equity inflows into Indian real estate increased 16% year-on-year to $4.5 billion during January-September 2026. Q3 inflows stood at $1.3 billion, with hospitality accounting for the largest share of quarterly investments at 26%.

news.title: TGIIC gearing up for fresh land auction in Raidurg
news.para: Next week, the Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation plans an exciting land auction in Raidurg, presenting two parcels of land spanning six to seven acres each. A senior TGIIC official revealed that the reserve price will likely be around Rs 200 crore per acre, with the auction scheduled strategically before Diwali to entice potential buyers and boost overall auction values.

news.title: Builders in West Bengal must have doctor, ambulance on construction sites with over 200 labourers
news.para: West Bengal's labour department has decreed that construction sites staffed by more than 200 workers must ensure the presence of a doctor at all times. Furthermore, an ambulance should be available to handle emergencies. Labour minister Arjun Singh recently convened with representatives from CREDAI to discuss these crucial measures. To uphold compliance, surprise inspections will be carried out, and any violations will face legal repercussions.

news.title: CM to launch four housing projects by Rajasthan housing board on October 17
news.para: Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma is poised to unveil four innovative projects by the Rajasthan Housing Board across Jaipur, Kishangarh, and Bhiwadi. A standout feature is the Special Registration Scheme catering specifically to accredited journalists in Indira Gandhi Nagar, Jaipur, offering tailored flats to fulfill their housing needs. Additionally, the second phase of Greenwood Horizon in Pratap Nagar will be introduced.

news.title: India ceramic tile exports fall 46% by volume in Apr-Jul 2026; FY27 outlook weak: Report
news.para: India’s ceramic tile exports fell 46% year-on-year by volume to 100 million sq metre during April-July 2026, while export value declined 34% to about ₹4,200 crore. Equirus expects FY27 exports to remain under pressure due to higher freight and energy costs, trade restrictions and disruption at the Morbi manufacturing cluster.

news.title: Delhi development body carries out land pooling policy campaign
news.para: Launching an extensive month-long campaign, the Delhi Development Authority is promoting its Land Pooling Policy. Covering an area of 200 square kilometers, this policy aims to facilitate approximately 12 lakh new housing solutions. Engaging local landowners and farmers through various village gatherings, the focus will be on explaining development methods.

news.title: Delhi: 99% of fire incidents in buildings without valid certificates; LG calls for integrated CCC
news.para: Delhi LG Taranjit Singh Sandhu emphasized the urgent need for a unified command control center to improve fire safety measures. He pointed out that many fires occur in unauthorized areas that lack proper safety certifications. The strategy involves modernizing fire service vehicles and establishing additional fire stations in vulnerable regions.

news.title: Omaxe to invest ₹4,000 crore in 10 hotel projects operated by Lemon Tree Hotels
news.para: Omaxe has signed an MoU with Carnation Hotels, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels, to operate 10 hotel projects comprising 4,000 keys across eight cities. The projects entail an estimated investment of about ₹4,000 crore and form part of Omaxe’s ₹6,200 crore hospitality expansion plan.

news.title: Oberoi Realty’s net profit rises marginally to ₹761.65 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Oberoi Realty announced a small increase in its net profit after tax for Q2 FY27. The company's total income showed a decrease from the previous fiscal year, impacting financial performance. For the first half of FY27, net consolidated profit saw a significant rise compared to H1 FY26. Additionally, the company declared a second interim dividend of ₹2 per equity share.

news.title: NITCO receives ₹143 crore from Kanjurmarg land transaction; eyes ₹250 crore from commercial space
news.para: NITCO has completed conveyance of 75% of its Kanjurmarg land to a Runwal group entity for ₹143 crore. For the remaining 25%, the company will receive one lakh sq ft of commercial RERA carpet area and expects to realise about ₹250 crore from its sale.

news.title: Architecture university to be set up Muzaffarpur: Bihar CM
news.para: In a significant boost to local industry, Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary officially launched a leather, footwear, and accessories cluster in Muzaffarpur, with an investment of Rs 140 crore aimed at generating employment opportunities. The project also includes plans for an architecture university named after the esteemed Shaheed Jubba Sahni, initiatives for rapid rail connectivity, and a vision to establish data centers with a goal of 1,000 MW capacity by 2030.

news.title: UPSIDA lowers qualifying score for allotment of industrial plots in Uttar Pradesh
news.para: Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority has lowered the minimum qualifying score for industrial land allotment. The decision aims to make industrial land more accessible to investors in the state. This will help broaden the pool of eligible applicants while maintaining the existing evaluation framework. The board also approved multiple development plans and directed immediate establishment of industrial units on allotted plots.

news.title: Gurugram civic body sets October 25 deadline to remove all 31 ready-mix concrete plants
news.para: The MCG has mandated the removal of 31 ready-mix concrete plants by October 25 as part of its strategy to combat air pollution in Gurgaon. MCG commissioner Pradeep Dahiya highlighted the importance of enforcing pollution-control measures. Additionally, officials are directed to amp up surveillance and ensure effective dust control at construction sites, all aimed at securing a healthier environment for Gurgaon residents.

news.title: Odisha extends rural housing scheme by two years, to build 2.91 lakh more houses
news.para: Odisha's Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi has unveiled a two-year extension of the rural housing initiative, with plans to construct an extra 2.91 lakh houses. The project maintains a budget of Rs 7,550 crore, with revised incentives of Rs 35,000 for beneficiaries who finish their homes promptly. A survey will identify new beneficiaries, aiming to achieve housing for every family in Odisha in the near future.

news.title: Mohali: Consumer forum orders PUDA to refund ₹14.5 lakh with interest
news.para: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission-II mandated PUDA to refund ₹14.5 lakh to Gurdeep Singh. Singh received an unfeasible plot in the Gateway City project in Mohali. The commission found PUDA guilty of unfair trade practice for not providing possession on time. Singh had acquired rights from a previous allottee and requested a refund citing the plot's marshy condition.

news.title: Gurugram civic body flags 87 unsafe buildings, set to raze them
news.para: In a proactive move to safeguard its residents, Gurgaon's civic body has pinpointed 87 hazardous buildings slated for demolition. The recent inspection unveiled alarming structural issues such as cracks and tilting. While show-cause notices have been dispatched to the owners of 66 structures, the action is still in process for the remaining ones.

news.title: Pune development body tightens water norms for building, occupancy approvals
news.para: The Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority has introduced a new requirement for developers: an assured water supply must now be obtained for building permissions. This revision seeks to enhance the reliability of water availability and supersedes earlier rules, affecting various types of developments. Developers of new residential and commercial projects must adhere to these updated standards to address community concerns over inadequate water supply in burgeoning areas.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board flats can now have lifts, on government land too
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board has greenlit lift installations in residential flats, focusing on better accessibility for all residents. This resolution came after a thorough committee evaluation, considering the growing need for enhanced mobility options. Residents can initiate the process by applying via registered architects and providing essential structural documentation. While unanimous neighbor agreement isn't necessary, those utilizing the new lift must split the associated costs.
